page_title: ATM 1-4 OSA | Atletico Madrid v Osasuna 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Yellow card. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+1' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
90' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

88' 1 - 4 Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:4.
84' Here is a change. Raul Garcia is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
83' 2:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
79' The attendance is 58401.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ruben Pena as he is replaced by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
71' Koke comes off the pitch to be replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (Atl. Madrid).
69' Osasuna have a corner.
64' 1 - 3 Goal! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) takes a short pass from Jesus Areso in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net. 1:3.
60' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) replaces Samuel Lino.
60' Substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta makes way for Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
59' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
56' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
55' The game has come to an end for Angel Correa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).

55' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Samuel Lino plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:2.
54' Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
52' 0 - 2 The attempt by Lucas Torro is blocked, but from inside of the box Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) hits the rebound into the back of the net. He alters the score to 0:2.
47' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Diego Simeone has made a change at the break. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) has come on in place of Gabriel Paulista.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

44' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Marcos Llorente. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
43' Atl. Madrid fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
43' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.

42' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.

41' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) produces a great solo run in the middle of the field, zig-zags through the opposition's defence at full speed and fires a powerful strike that crashes against the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
40' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

40' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' Gabriel Paulista (Atl. Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
31' Ruben Garcia is being substituted because of an injury. Jagoba Arrasate sends Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) on the pitch.
30' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' 0 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Alejandro Catena and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 0:1.
26' Osasuna will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
19' Osasuna keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
14' Flag up against Ruben Pena (Osasuna). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
13' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
12' The ball is cleared after Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
10' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Now Osasuna have a corner.
10' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) heads on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes was nominated as the referee for this game.
